title: GHO Lens
tagline: Immerse yourself in the dynamic GHO Ecosystem for real-time insights. Explore Markets, Facilitators, monitor DeFi metrics, and stay informed about network activities.
description:
GHO Lens: Empowering DeFi Analytics

Introducing GHO Lens, your all-in-one portal to navigate the Aave ecosystem's decentralized finance (DeFi) landscape centered around the GHO steblecoin. From real-time market trends to advanced details of Aave's markets, GHO Lens empowers users to make informed decisions based on rich data.

The following main features are being included:

Dashboard:
Quickly grasp the current state of Aave's DeFi markets. Stay informed about trends, liquidity, and key metrics, enabling you to make timely and well-informed decisions.

Markets:
Dive deep into Aave's ecosystem with comprehensive insights into supply assets, borrowing rates, and yield opportunities. Whether you're a liquidity provider or borrower, optimize your strategy with detailed market information.

Facilitators:
GHO introduces Facilitators, entities trusted to mint and burn GHO tokens through secure strategies. Explore the Facilitator Diagram, discover current entities, and understand their role in the GHO ecosystem.

User Profile:
Tailor your GHO experience with personalized data. Track liquidity contributions, monitor borrowed amounts, and stay updated  with the Aave ecosystem, ensuring your DeFi journey aligns with your unique needs.

Empowering DeFi Interaction:
GHO Lens transcends data aggregation! it's a tool to empower DeFi users. Whether adding liquidity, borrowing assets, or navigating the Aave ecosystem, GHO Lens is your guide. Join us in redefining decentralized finance with GHO Lens.

Looking Ahead:
While currently providing data insights, GHO Lens aims to evolve beyond observation. Future plans include enabling users to actively participate in markets by offering collateral and borrowing, 	provide the infrastructure to create new potential Facilitators for GHO
how_its_made: GHO Lens utilises Ethereum smart contracts to display data directly from the blockchain. More specifically, the smart contracts are queried with Ethers.js to provide data that I later used to populate different pages of the UI. In addition, I have implemented a couple of APIs, such as Etherscan API, to fetch and display data regarding user holdings and ticket prices. In order to achieve the above, I chose to work with Next.js 14 which offers a variety of build-in tools, such as as file based routing, SSR which aim to make the developer experience easier and of course pleasant while at the same time boosting the app performance. Another important part of the process, is the utilisation of Typescript to provide type safety since we work with sensitive data and queries.  For the Front-end part I used Tailwind.css and on top of that shadcn, which is a popular, newly introduced tool built on top of Tailwind.css helping with even more utility when styling.
